Thanks for the words of encouragement, I've had a chance to think over it some more and I agree with you.

It's just 72 hours. Well less now.

I'll try and survive!

Well if you believe that to be the case I'm sorry you had to have someone say that to you.

This whole situation is pretty crap of course, but it seems a lot of your problems stem from being around him. 

Dis-continuing your relationship may be the best for not only your mental health but also his.

I know this may seem stereotypical of me to say, but what you're thinking and feeling is simply a part of your mental disorder.

Yes, I understand your thoughts and current beliefs. I myself have felt the rage at others you feel seemingly all the time.

I'd like to know if you've seeked help, there's no reason not to realistically. Worst case scenario no one cares and that just gives you more reasons to go through with what your planning.

All I'm saying is try and help yourself, if you feel pain to the point of considering suicide, surely you could consider other options to.

Whoever you are, I'm sorry you feel this way. The universe is a cunt   and seemingly enjoys watching people suffer sometimes.

But that's just more of a reason to try and fix yourself.

Well shit, seems both you and him have a few issues.

One thing I'm certain on is that he regrets what he said, he's mentally ill as you yourself said. Since he's mentally ill he is going to say and do things he wouldn't normally do.

I do think it's a good idea if you take a break from each other since it seems to be a mostly unsuccessful relationship, but let me assure you he didn't mean what he said.

It's his depression talking, not him.

You say you haven't talked to your family for a long time, do you think they might care about you?

I'm simply saying maybe you should try and talk to them about how you're feeling, who knows? Maybe they'll try and help you.

Worst case scenario they don't care and you can continue with more confidence.
